description: A glamorous, deeply saturated living room with a strong Art Deco or contemporary luxury aesthetic. The feature wall is clad in rich dark walnut vertical slat paneling with a central architectural inset frame surrounding a large blush-toned painted or upholstered panel insert, giving the composition a jewel-box quality. Heavy dark chocolate velvet drapes hang floor-to-ceiling on the left edge, admitting only a slim vertical slice of bright daylight. The curved sofa is an oversized semicircular form upholstered in deep burnt terracotta velvet with a low, opulent silhouette — almost architectural in its sweep. It holds two throw pillows: one in chocolate brown velvet and one in a woven oat or warm linen. In front of the sofa sits a large oval coffee table with a polished black Nero Marquina marble top and bold cylindrical matte black pedestals as legs. On the table rest a brushed gold lidded canister and two crystal whisky tumblers partially filled. A small cylindrical matte black side table stands at the left sofa end. A cream woven area rug anchors the seating group on what appears to be light stone flooring. A warm amber glow emanates from the walnut wall panel area, casting soft warm light across the slatted wood texture and the sofa back. The palette is deeply warm — burnt orange, espresso, blush, and gold. Camera is at seated to standing eye-level, normal lens, three-quarter corner view showing the sofa, coffee table, and feature wall.
